description.zh: 阿里云容器服务Kubernetes版的Kubernetes集群的ID。
description.en: The ID of the ACK cluster.

description.zh: 集群类型，包括：ACK、ASK、cloud-product-prometheus和Node。虚拟集群可通过集群类型查询大盘列表。InfluxDB类云产品统一传`cloud-product-prometheus`。
description.en: Valid values: ACK, ASK, cloud-product-prometheus, and Node. You can query the dashboards of a virtual cluster by specifying the cluster type. For InfluxDB, set this parameter to `cloud-product-prometheus`.

description.zh: 大盘唯一名称，可筛选查询指定名称的大盘。相对于**Title**参数，**Title**可能会发生变化，name不会。并且支持指定多个name，以半角逗号（,）分隔，例如：`k8s-event,k8s-overview`。同一个大盘名称会有多个版本，如果要指定版本，可以在name后面增加版本信息，例如：`k8s-event:v1,k8s-overview:latest`。
description.en: The unique names of the dashboards. You can query dashboards by specifying their names. The **dashboard title** can be changed whereas the **dashboard name** cannot. You can specify multiple names and separate them with commas (,), for example, `k8s-event,k8s-overview`. A dashboard may have multiple versions. If you want to specify a version, you can add version information after the name, for example, `k8s-event:v1,k8s-overview:latest`.

description.zh: 指定返回的Grafana大盘的语言，参数值包括en 、 zh ，默认值为en。
description.en: The language of the returned Grafana dashboard. Valid values: en and zh. Default value: en.

description.zh: 云产品Code，可选。当`clusterType=cloud-product-prometheus`时该字段必传。目前已经接入的云产品有：SAE、MSE、RocketMQ、Lindorm、Kafka、Clickhouse、DLA、消息队列RabbitMQ版、云数据库MongoDB版、时序数据库InfluxDB、MSE服务-云原生网关、Grafana服务、分布式调度平台SchedulerX、MSE服务-全局事务、企业级分布式应用服务EDAS、机器学习平台PAI-EAS、应用高可用服务AHAS、性能测试PTS。
description.en: The cloud service code. This parameter is required if you set the ClusterType parameter to `cloud-product-prometheus`. The following cloud services are available: Serverless App Engine, Microservices Engine, Message Queue for Apache RocketMQ, Lindorm, Message Queue for Apache Kafka, ApsaraDB for ClickHouse, Data Lake Analytics, Message Queue for RabbitMQ, ApsaraDB for MongoDB, Time Series Database (TSDB) for InfluxDB, MSE Cloud-native Gateway, Grafana Service, SchedulerX, Global Transaction Service, Enterprise Distributed Application Service, Machine Learning Platform for AI - Elastic Algorithm Service (EAS), Application High Availability Service, and Performance Testing.

description.zh: 创建或者查询虚拟集群开关参数，可以对老数据兼容控制。
description.en: Specifies whether to create or query a virtual cluster. This parameter provides backward compatibility.

description.zh: 指定大盘标题。大盘标题可能会修改，建议使用**DashboardName**查询。
description.en: The dashboard title. The dashboard title can be changed. We recommend that you specify the **DashboardName** parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-dashboards --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --cluster-type Node --biz-language en --title ApiServer --product xxxx --recreate-switch false --dashboard-name k8s-node-overview --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListDashboards --region cn-hangzhou --DashboardName 'k8s-node-overview' --Language en --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --Title ApiServer --Product xxxx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClusterType Node --RecreateSwitch false
